findings.explanation: The PR changes the access control filter logic for team-based project access in a way that introduces incorrect authorization. In the base version (lines 57-64), when BOTH admin and member are True, the filter allows projects from BOTH admin AND read-only teams via OR logic: `filter |= Q(teams__access=ADMIN_ACCESS)` OR `filter |= Q(teams__access=READ_ONLY_ACCESS)`. In the PR version (lines 57-67), when BOTH admin and member are True, the else clause (line 62-64) applies NO access level filter at all - it just has a pass statement. This means users requesting both admin=True and member=True get ALL projects regardless of team access level, bypassing the intended access control that restricts admin access to ADMIN_ACCESS teams and member access to READ_ONLY_ACCESS teams. According to the security policy, 'Admin' teams provide full administrative access while 'Read Only' teams provide only read access. The PR removes the ability to distinguish between these access levels when both flags are set.
